snippet.title: Remaking ROBLOX Obbying in Godot (DEVLOG 7)
snippet.description:
What is Obby Revival Project?
Obby Revival Project. A ROBLOX like game trying to recreate the feel of r6 obbying with some extra features, due to roblox's new additions

Wow, it's been a week since the last devlog and we already made all these changes, it's crazy that in 2 weeks I revived Obby Revival Project and made it actually good, huge shoutout to the awesome contributors who helped with orp.

MUSIC USED (IN ORDER):
flowers at lunchtime - maru.wav, Kataraxia
Bôa - Duvet (Zenkaso Remix)
ANGEL TEARS - FTFLFRAME
heavensleep - Oneheart
yours forever - usedcvnt, abyssal.angel

0:00 Devlog
1:56 Showcase
10:15 Outro
